observations.content:
Summary: The sources confirm that GPT-3 has 175 billion parameters. This is stated in the 311 Institute article, Wikipedia, the Lambda AI blog, the NVIDIA technical blog, and a YouTube video that details the calculation of GPT-3’s parameters. The 311 Institute article, Wikipedia, the Lambda AI blog, and the NVIDIA technical blog all compare GPT-3’s size to previous models, noting that it is significantly larger than GPT-2 and other Transformer-based models. The YouTube video provides a detailed breakdown of how the total parameter count is derived from various components of the model.
